17/G.goal: Explain how IMU-based XR tracking obtains usable sensor data and maintains an orientation estimate by calibrating IMU readings, registering and integrating orientation, and correcting drift.
17/G.achieves: Provides foundational understanding of XR tracking technology that helps the learner understand headset tracking, assess tracking issues, and later build or optimize XR systems.

17/O1.goal: Explain the preparation of IMU motion data for XR tracking, from raw gyroscope, accelerometer, and magnetometer readings to calibrated sensor values.
17/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a sensor-level foundation for understanding how low-cost XR tracking devices obtain trustworthy motion input.

17/O2.goal: Describe how an XR tracking system maintains orientation by registering an initial pose, integrating calibrated angular velocity, and applying drift correction.
17/O2.achieves: Lets the learner understand how calibrated motion data become a maintained orientation estimate, supporting later work on XR system development and optimization.
